Elif, Finn and Gus must sit in consecutive slots, as must Ben and Hana, and Ann and Ivo. The remaining constraints then fix the order.

- Ben is before Finn, and Hana is right after Ben. Hana cannot be Elif, so Ben and Hana both come before Elif.
- Cara is before Dev, and Dev is before Ben. So Cara and Dev come before Ben.
- Elif is before Ann, and Ann is not in the Elif–Finn–Gus block. So Ann and Ivo come after Gus.

That gives Cara, Dev, Ben, Hana, Elif, Finn, Gus, Ann, Ivo, and it is the only order that works.

Check against every constraint:
- Hana is in slot 4 and Ivo in slot 9, five apart, which is at least three.
- Gus (7) is before Ivo (9).
- Cara (1) is before Ann (8) and before Dev (2).
- Elif (5) is before Ann (8) and before Gus (7).
- Ben (3) is before Finn (6).
- Gus (7) is right after Finn (6).
- Hana (4) is right after Ben (3).
- Finn (6) is right after Elif (5).
- Dev (2) is before Ben (3).
- Ivo (9) is right after Ann (8).
